name: F-TIDE
tagline: A decision-tree tool for assessing flood warning towers: guided questions, a delivery risk score and an exportable report.
about: Published as FWIN-ONSM-Matrix. Load a decision tree (tree.json), answer its questions about a tower, and export a self-contained HTML report with the path taken, the outcome and a Delivery Risk Score. The tree is edited in the browser (guided editor, a Cytoscape tree map, branches) and saved with a SHA-256-hashed changelog; a station register CSV the user loads fills in each site's details. It serves the same network's sites as Flood-Net but shares no code or data with it; Flood-Net neither absorbed nor replaced it.

status.summary: Working and published; the rule set (v57.2) was last edited in June 2026 and the app last built in July, with nothing since but a CLAUDE.md note.

components.name: Evaluation runner
components.what: Walks the tree question by question, keeps the path and the running risk score, flags missing rules.

components.name: Rule set
components.what: The tower decision tree, its JSON Schema and its hashed version history.

components.name: Tree editor and map
components.what: Guided and raw-JSON node editor, Cytoscape tree map, branch forking, save with changelog.

components.name: Station lookup
components.what: Loads a station register CSV the user supplies and fills each session's site details.

components.name: Report export
components.what: A self-contained, printable HTML report of the decision path, outcome and risk band.

components.name: Bundle build
components.what: Concatenates modules/ and app.js into app.bundle.js, which the page loads.
